description: The 0.3 suite's quarter-turn winder stair (stairs/014 of conformance/core/0.3), exactly as it is there, declaring "0.3", read by a reader of 0.4: valid, with the same hash and canonical form, and every value 0.3 derives for it; and, as 0.4 derives them for a stair of any draft, its winders, walkline, goings and headroom. A 0.3 reader reports FS-LINT-016 for the winder stair; a 0.4 reader derives its steps, and reports FS-LINT-018 for winders that narrow to a point.
